title: JBSS Exim
short: JBSS Exim is a corporate website with an integrated CMS that showcases industrial products, automation solutions, company information, and business services.
detail: JBSS Exim is a corporate website with a built-in CMS (Content Management System) built for an Indian industrial export company based in Nashik, Maharashtra, dealing in Metal Profile Wires, Electrical Panels, Industrial Machines, and Automation solutions. The frontend is built using React 18, TypeScript, Vite, and TailwindCSS, featuring a fully responsive public website with sections for Products, About, Portfolio, Quality, Blog, and Contact, while the backend is a lightweight Node.js/Express server running on port 3005 that stores all CMS content in a JSON flat file. The admin can log in at /login with credentials (admin/admin), manage all website content including text, images, hero slides, team members, and contact details through a tabbed dashboard, and save changes that instantly reflect on the live public site — with the frontend always falling back to default hardcoded data if the backend is offline.

title: Nirikhyana Puri
short: Bilingual English/Odia dashboards with role-based healthcare workflows, responsive interfaces and API integration.
detail: MatruSaathi (Nirikhyana Puri) is a maternal health management web application developed for the Government of Odisha, Health & Family Welfare Department, using React 18 and Vite. It provides role-based access for District Officers, Block Level users, ANMs, and USG Centres, supporting pregnancy tracking, high-risk case monitoring, ANC completion, USG scheduling and reports, grievance management, and block-wise analytics, with English and Odia language support and a responsive interface for desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.

title: CREATE ICIL
short: A modern CMS-powered website for the CREATE Incubation Centre at IIIT Lucknow, designed to promote entrepreneurship, support startups, showcase mentors, and provide incubation and registration opportunities.
detail: CREATE ICIL is a content-managed website for the Confederation for Research, Entrepreneurship & Technology Enablement at IIIT Lucknow. The platform highlights the incubation centre's mission, startup ecosystem, mentors, gallery, tenders, and contact information. It features a prominent hero section, announcement banner for workshops and startup expos, and clear calls to action for startup incubation applications and exploring startups. The CMS enables administrators to manage website content, announcements, images, and key informational sections efficiently.

title: Vyavastha
short: Accounts Payable management platform for streamlining vendor management, invoice processing, approvals, and user access through an intuitive, data-driven dashboard
detail: Vyavastha is a comprehensive Accounts Payable and Vendor Management web application designed to streamline invoice processing, vendor management, user and role administration, and tenant management. The platform includes an interactive dashboard for tracking invoice statuses, payment amounts, pending approvals, processing errors, and document uploads, with features such as invoice upload, CSV/Excel exports, role-based access control, permissions management, and secure authentication.

title: DigiDocs
short: Document management platform that simplifies file organization, approval workflows, and team collaboration.
detail: DigiDocs is a modern document management web application designed to simplify document storage, file organization, team collaboration, and approval workflows. It features an interactive dashboard for monitoring document activity, pending approvals, storage usage, and recent uploads. The platform includes document uploads, categorized libraries, advanced search and filtering, version control, and multi-stage approval management. It also provides secure authentication, role-based access, permission management, and team activity tracking. The UI/UX focuses on intuitive navigation, clean layouts, consistent visual design, and efficient user interactions. The responsive interface ensures a seamless experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

title: ISKCON Nashik
short: A responsive, CMS-based website for ISKCON Nashik, showcasing temple information, spiritual programs, initiatives, galleries, books, and donation opportunities.
detail: Developed a modern website for Sri Sri Radha Madan Gopal Temple, ISKCON Nashik, to provide devotees and visitors with easy access to temple information and spiritual resources. The website features dedicated pages for About, Programs, Gallery, Books, Services, Initiatives, Contact, and Donations. Its user-friendly navigation and responsive layout help visitors explore temple activities, discover spiritual programs, view photographs, access books, and support temple initiatives through online donations. The CMS-based architecture allows administrators to manage website content and keep information updated efficiently.
client: ISKCON Nashik – Sri Sri Radha Madan Gopal Temple

title: SPAARASH Fragrances
short: Designed and developed a premium, responsive e-commerce website for Spaarrash Fragrances, showcasing luxury perfumes, attars, home fragrances, and curated fragrance.
detail:
Spaarrash Fragrances is a luxury fragrance brand inspired by the timeless traditions of Hindu spirituality and the art of perfumery. The website presents a sophisticated digital storefront featuring premium perfumes, attars, home fragrances, and non-alcoholic perfumes.

The project focuses on creating an elegant visual identity and seamless browsing experience with curated product collections, category-based navigation, promotional banners, featured products, brand storytelling, and fragrance-related editorial content. The interface also highlights customer trust, product quality, special offers, and newsletter subscriptions to support customer engagement and product discovery.

The website combines refined aesthetics with responsive layouts and intuitive navigation to communicate the brand's commitment to elegance, quality, and memorable fragrance experiences.

title: BHOOKAD
short: Bhookad is a modern food ordering mobile PWA UI design that delivers a seamless food discovery, online ordering, checkout, and order-tracking experience through an intuitive, mobile-first interface.
detail:
Bhookad is a food delivery Progressive Web App (PWA) UI/UX design concept created to make online food ordering simple, convenient, and engaging. The design focuses on a smooth user journey, from discovering popular cuisines and browsing food items to managing a cart, completing payments, and tracking orders in real time.

The interface includes user authentication, account verification, password recovery, food categories, popular items, product details, search and recent searches, wishlist, cart management, delivery address management, multiple payment methods, coupon codes, order confirmation, and delivery tracking.

The design also features user profiles, order history, notifications, help and support, and bottom navigation for easy access to key sections. With a clean mobile-first layout and intuitive navigation, Bhookad aims to deliver a convenient and consistent food ordering experience across mobile devices.

title: ANc – Wireless Earbuds E-commerce Website UI Design
short: ANc is a premium audio product website UI design showcasing wireless earbuds through immersive visuals, modern layouts, product discovery, and an engaging shopping experience.
detail:
ANc is a modern e-commerce website UI design concept for a wireless earbuds brand, created to highlight premium audio products through a stylish and engaging digital experience. The design combines bold typography, product-focused visuals, and clean layouts to communicate sound quality, innovation, and brand identity.

The website features a hero section with product highlights, interactive 3D product viewing, product collections, audio experience showcases, customer testimonials, and newsletter subscription. The navigation includes Home, About, Shop, FAQ, and Contact Us, helping users explore the brand and discover different earbuds models.

title: Art Studio
short: A modern digital art marketplace connecting artists and art lovers through curated artwork collections, artist profiles, and a seamless online shopping experience.
detail:
Art Studio is a thoughtfully designed digital platform that showcases exceptional artwork and connects talented artists with art enthusiasts worldwide. The website features curated art collections, featured artists, detailed artist profiles, and a user-friendly browsing experience. With secure shopping, personalized recommendations, wishlist functionality, and artist registration, the platform makes discovering and collecting art simple and engaging.

The design combines elegant typography, refined layouts, and visually rich artwork displays to create a premium art discovery experience for homes, offices, and gifting.
